development.label: DEVELOPMENT ONLY: T1 on R11C_DEV seed 31 (split R12DEV), T2 on R12C_DEV seed 41; no confirmation seed, namespace or split was used

episodes.probe_rule: the same 32 observed support pairs, inputs in query format [x, 0, 1], run WITHOUT context; targets enter only the support loss

question: Inside R11's actual Stage C ERSA stack, does restoring the exact episode-local update of the LAST block's 120-parameter specialist core (R11 Stage B's 8 clipped SGD steps on the observed support) recover CGC's specialist advantage over the FFN-only stack and over a matched fast-adapted GELU specialist?

T1.name: R11 Stage C models, rebuilt from their recorded seeds with R11's own code
T1.training: R11 amendment_stage_c training, unchanged (never trained for adaptation)
T1.verification: each rebuilt arm's R11 TEST rows, trace and selected step equal the committed R11 record (bitwise); a mismatch is reported and the group is NONQUAL

T2.name: the same stack trained with the fast update in the loop (episodic objective)
T2.training: R11's training plan (Adam 3e-3, cosine, 2,000 steps of 16 episodes, k from the grid, DEV selection at k = 32 every 250 steps) with ONE change: a specialist arm's query pass runs under its last-block core adapted on that step's probes (first-order outer gradient), and its DEV score is taken after adaptation. G0 trains with R11's train_stack.

representation_stage.procedure: a separate amendment, frozen before any of its data; oracle task coordinates are diagnosis only and never part of a claimed path

better.method: pooled geometric-mean ratio over all paired episodes (12 groups x 12 episodes), one-sided exact sign test on the paired log ratios, and the fraction of (family, seed) groups with a geometric mean below 1

dispositions.ASSAY_NOT_LEARNED: the FFN-only stack does not learn the in-context assay
dispositions.INTEGRATED_FAST_CGC_SPECIALIST_QUALIFIED: all six criteria (per regime, per gate mode)
dispositions.NOT_ESTABLISHED: integrity and assay hold, some other criterion fails

rules.gate_modes: G2 (fixed g = 1) and G1 (learned gate, init 0.1) are judged separately; no pooling
integrity_gates: reset before the queries restores the frozen output bit for bit
updates disabled (all else identical) leave the frozen output bit for bit, every attempt refused REFUSED_LEARNING_DISABLED
no probe token carries a target; no query input equals a support input
the recurrent states of a full recomputation under the adapted core equal the frozen states bit for bit
cached and full-recomputation outputs agree within 1e-5
every update APPLIED; the delta bound never binds; every value finite
rules.multiplicity: four primary judgements (2 regimes x 2 gate modes) are reported separately, uncorrected; a qualification is stated only for the arm and regime that meet every criterion
rules.primary_endpoint: query MSE with the 32 support pairs in context after 8 fast steps (fast8)

qualification.adaptation_curve: arm fast8 better than the same arm frozen (k = 32, 0 steps)
qualification.assay_learned: G0's median frozen k = 32 query MSE <= 0.5 x the zero predictor's, every group
qualification.beats_fast_gelu: arm fast8 better than G3 fast8 (same update budget: 120 core values, 8 steps)
qualification.beats_ffn: arm fast8 better than G0 (frozen, k = 32)
qualification.integrity: every integrity gate holds for the arm and for G3
qualification.target_driven: arm fast8 better than the same arm adapted on permuted support targets

reading.NONQUAL: integrity failure or a missing record
reading.NOT_ESTABLISHED_REPRESENTATION_STAGE_TRI: no arm qualifies in either regime (the representation stage then needs its own frozen amendment)
reading.QUALIFIED_ONLY_WITH_ADAPTATION_TRAINED_I: no T1 arm qualifies, a T2 arm does

secondary: interference: this episode's queries under the previous episode's adapted core
reliance: the last block's specialist ablated (frozen)
projection alignment: R^2 of P_in(h) on the probe inputs
gradient norms, clipping, cosine of successive updates
stopping: no rerun of a confirmation record
no threshold or endpoint changed after a result
no change of the fast-update protocol, the bound or the geometry to rescue a result
no K1, LAO, RALPH, larger core, extra experts, new memory tier or native/GGUF code
a failed run is recorded as failed
